'''Imperial Navy Troopers''', also known as ''' Star Destroyer troopers''' or just '''Naval Troopers''', were soldiers in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who were assigned by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] as part of [[Imperial Fleet Regiment]]s to serve as guards, military police and soldiers onboard its many [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] and other installations, such as the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]].

==Description==
===Role===
{{Quote|During a boarding action, you're more likely to fight naval troopers than stormtroopers.|Crix Madine|<ref name="Imperial Handbook">''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Imperial_Navy_Trooper.jpg|thumb|left|130px|An Imperial Navy trooper in full uniform.]]
Members of the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] believed that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] Navy troopers were considered a joke and that such [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] rarely ever expected to enter into combat engagements. While this was the opinion of SpecForce members, this was not entirely true, as [[Navy/Legends|Navy]] troopers tended to be both well-equipped and adequately trained for their tasks. In addition, they did see combat, but tended to lack the edge that blooded troops got from their engagements. Vessels and installations that were located in more remote regions tended to rely more on their Navy [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]]. In some cases, such as those units stationed in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], the Navy soldiers had gained enough experience to be a credible threat to their enemies. However, in general, Imperial Navy troopers were not considered a challenge to members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecOps]].<ref name="RoE:TRSH">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>

These men backed up [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and were created to provide the Imperial Navy a corps of troops separate from the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] for protection of their ships. After the initial boarding operations were conducted by Stormtroopers, Imperial Navy troopers often moved in to conduct mop up actions.<ref name="RoE:TRSH" /> However, [[Crix Madine/Legends|Crix Madine]], a former Imperial soldier-turned Rebel General, indicated that the naval troopers are more likely to be encountered during a boarding action.<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />

[[File:ImperialFleetRegiment-SWR.png|thumb|right|200px|An Imperial Fleet Regiment]]
Besides serving the Galactic Empire as soldiers and security guards, they handled hangar control traffic, monitored [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] arrays, and performed various other duties.

Some of the best Imperial Navy troopers were selected to become [[Death Star Trooper/Legends|Death Star troopers]].<ref name="Death Star Novel" /> On the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] they guarded the main conference room and both arrested and escorted prisoners to their cells.<ref name="Episode IV" /> On the second [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star]] they controlled the deflector shield and superlaser from the [[Death Star command center]].<ref name="Episode VI" />

Some were selected to serve in the [[Imperial Naval Special Forces|Imperial Navy Special Forces]].

===Uniform===
Imperial Navy troopers wore a black uniform and a swooping black protective helmet.<ref name="Episode V" /> Their primary weapon was either a [[DH-17 blaster pistol/Legends|DH-17 blaster pistol]] or an [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]] which were supplemented with a standard [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]].

==History==
[[File:HoseDown-GalacticHunters.png|thumb|250px|left|An Imperial Navy Trooper firing a heavy blaster]]
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], low-ranking Navy troopers piloted and monitored the orbital climate control mirrors around [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. This was known as ''"riding the mirrors"'' and was considered the loneliest as well as most tedious assignment at the Galactic Capital.<ref name="TISU">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>

From [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Death Star troopers, the subgroup of Imperial Navy troopers served aboard the first Death Star. One of their members, [[Nova Stihl]], attempted to escape the Death Star during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], but was killed. When the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] managed to blow up the Death Star, all Death Star troopers aboard the battlestation were killed.<ref name="Death Star Novel" />

[[File:VaderNeeda-TESB40.png|thumb|180px|right|Imperial Navy troopers watch as Darth Vader kills Lorth Needa.]]
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Imperial Navy troopers on the ''[[Executor/Legends|Executor]]'' were ordered to drag away the body of [[Lorth Needa/Legends|Lorth Needa]], after he was killed by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] for losing the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]''.<ref name="Episode V" />

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Death Star troopers served aboard the second Death Star and the [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] moon in the [[Endor shield generator bunker]]. During the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], many of the troopers aboard the Death Star fled their posts, with those remaining being killed when the battlestation exploded.<ref name="Episode VI" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Navy Trooper was sold by [[the LEGO Group]] in 2008's Death Star, 2009's Battle of Endor, and 2012's TIE Fighter sets. These characters are not to be mixed up with the [[Imperial gunner/Legends|Imperial gunners]], although the [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed|''Force Unleashed'']] video game features a similar Imperial militia group called the [[Imperial Navy commando]]s.
